name: Mario Bortolanza Regional Scholarship
summary: Up to $20,000 for students relocating from regional Queensland to start a music degree at the Queensland Conservatorium.
key: Up to $5,000 per year, up to $20,000 in total including honours.
who: Commencing full-time in an undergraduate music degree at the Queensland Conservatorium in 2027.
Relocating from a rural, regional or remote location in Queensland.
Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Offered again in 2027; no closing date published yet.
